result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main defect is in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the first two cards are exact duplicates (same name, image, time and delivery fee). There are also minor contrast and consistency issues.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical cards, 'Green Bowl Poké', with the same image, 15–25 min and €0.90 delivery. This looks like a duplicated data or rendering bug and wastes prime carousel space.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the list by restaurant ID and check the data source or rendering logic so each restaurant appears once.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0.. delivery · Ramen') and the gray inactive tab labels have low contrast against the white and light backgrounds. The search placeholder text is also faint.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The time badges on the carousel cards sit over the image and overlap its bottom-left corner. They look cramped and inconsistent with the top-left badges on the large cards ('€0 delivery', '−20%').
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge placement and padding across card types.

issues.description: The decorative circles on the right of the green promo banner are low-contrast, and the banner's rounded shapes look arbitrary. The heart icon on the pizza card sits on a dark translucent circle that is barely visible against the busy image.
issues.suggestion: Simplify the banner decoration and give the favorite button a more solid background or clearer contrast.
